audience: fleet managers and dispatchers who track vehicles, drivers and orders in Webfleet

useCases.title: See where vehicles are now
useCases.text: List the vehicles and objects with their last known position, then read the master data of one vehicle.

useCases.title: Find the vehicles nearest to a customer
useCases.text: Find the eight nearest vehicles to an address of the account, with the routed distance and time.

useCases.title: Review trips and events of a period
useCases.text: List the trips in a relative date range, and the events with their acknowledged and resolved state.

useCases.title: Review orders and their drivers
useCases.text: List the orders with their state and destination, then list the active drivers of the account.

useCases.title: Add a customer address
useCases.text: Create one address in the address book with a unique number and a name. The call adds a record and changes no other record.
